flags.why: This expression belongs to North Central Vietnamese, so the Northern tag is misleading ([Wiktionary](https://en.wiktionary.org/wiki/b%E1%BB%AFa_di%E1%BA%BFp)).
The translation reverses the visitor and host: chị visited tui's home.
flags.fix: The other day you came by my place, but I wasn't in.
